description: Issue #52: an unanswered planner question is a warning, not just a note. #320 states no acceptance criteria and #321 names no file, so the run is partial rather than a clean success — the plan no longer reports 'nothing to see here' about an issue with no stated definition of done. This is also the BLOCKING half of Issue #199's split, pinned from the other side of case 53: both codes are outside the notice set, so both entries carry no `severity` at all (absent IS blocking, fail-closed) and the run is `partial` exactly as it was before severity existed. A change that widened the notice set past its one code would turn this case red.

warning_details_include: #320: Acceptance criteria are unclear; add 1-3 concrete completion checks.
#321: Affected files are unclear; add likely modules or paths.
The dispatch runner refuses an issue with an unanswered question
